text:
Help, in King Jesus' name! The church cannot save the wretch, for his killer entered holy ground, fearing neither royal house nor sacred place.


Help justice, bring lights, chase him, seize the culprit; he waits cloaked for the watch.


They seized him because his sword exceeded regulation; but seeing it bloody,


justice asked who he was. He uncovered: I am Death. Are you Death? Go on in peace.

translation.title: Sonnet to Death
